data.explanation: Your property manager noticed that part of November's rent and the 2025 operating cost (Nebenkosten) balance are still unpaid, totaling €526.42. They ask you to transfer this amount by 7 December 2026. If you cannot pay in full now, contact them to arrange installments (Ratenvereinbarung), as they offer. If you ignore this, it could lead to further reminders, late fees, or eventually legal steps, so it's best to pay or respond before the deadline. Check your bank transfers to confirm whether this amount is actually still open.
